questions.q: What does Msimangu propose to Kumalo on the train back to Sophiatown?
choices: That Kumalo return home at once
That Kumalo rest for a while and come with him to Ezenzeleni, the place of the blind
That they hire a private detective
That they go to the police
questions.explain: 'While I work, you can rest'; the young man at the reformatory will search better than they can.

choices: A place where white people work to help black people who are blind
questions.explain: Msimangu goes there to hold a service and attend to their own people.

questions.q: Who is the rosy-cheeked priest who talks with Kumalo about England that evening?
questions.explain: He speaks of hedges and fields, Westminster Abbey and the great cathedrals.

questions.q: What headline does the priest bring from the city in the Evening Star?
choices: 'MURDER IN PARKWOLD. WELL-KNOWN CITY ENGINEER SHOT DEAD. ASSAILANTS THOUGHT TO BE NATIVES'
questions.explain: The dead man is Arthur Jarvis.

choices: A city engineer and a 'great fighter for justice', President of the African Boys' Club in Claremont
questions.explain: He was also 'one of the finest of all our young laymen' of the Church.

questions.q: How is Arthur Jarvis connected to Kumalo's home district?
choices: He was the only child of Mr James Jarvis of High Place, Carisbrooke — the farm in the hills above Ndotsheni
questions.explain: Kumalo knows the father by sight and remembers 'a small bright boy' who rode past the church.

questions.q: According to the newspaper report, where and how was Arthur Jarvis killed?
choices: In the street outside his office
Shot dead at short range in the passage of his house after coming down to investigate a noise in the kitchen
questions.explain: His wife and children were away; the servant Richard Mpiring was knocked unconscious in the kitchen.

questions.q: What was found on the table by the murdered man?
choices: An unfinished manuscript titled 'The Truth About Native Crime', and a pipe whose bowl was still warm
questions.explain: He had got up from writing it to go to his death.

questions.q: How many children does Arthur Jarvis leave?
choices: A nine-year-old son and a five-year-old daughter
questions.explain: He leaves a widow and two young children.

questions.q: How does Kumalo respond at the end of the chapter when Msimangu urges him to pray?
choices: 'There is no prayer left in me. I am dumb here inside. I have no words at all.'
He goes straight to the prison
He blames the young white man
questions.explain: 'Here in my heart there is nothing but fear. Fear, fear, fear.'
